note: Every number below is copied from the Bible section named in its 'bible' field. Nothing is interpolated, rounded, or invented. Stations marked severity 'reference' or 'info' are recorded proportions the figure gate does not pass/fail; see README.md.

procedureFactors.bible: §5 Proportion bands — Production acceptance row: 'The chibi procedure's factors live in chibi-params.json (thigh/shin 0.78×, arms 0.82×, head mesh 1.30× about the neck pivot, clavicles +8%, hands 1.15×).'
procedureFactors.notes: Multipliers the chibi procedure applies to a base rig (clavicles +8% recorded as the equivalent 1.08×). These are inputs to figure production — the values intake tuning adjusts — not measurements of a finished figure, so the gate does not check a GLB against them.

source: build/visual/LOOK-BIBLE-V0.md (v0-DRAFT; freezes as Look Bible v1.0 only at G-J4)

stations.bible: §5 Proportion bands — Production acceptance (V-05, script-measured on the rig)
stations.notes: Bible: 'Head = 40–43% of height (heads-tall 2.33–2.50 derived). A rig outside this is not decimated, not rendered.' Heads-tall is the derived reciprocal (1/0.43–1/0.40), not a separate station.

stations.bible: §5 Proportion bands — Look target (V-10, L2 scoring of acceptance captures)
stations.notes: Bible §5 closing note: a figure at 42–43% passes production and this station's wider context but sits above the target — 'scored look-dulling at most, tuned at ladder rung 5.1'. Reported as its own line; a miss here does not fail the gate (see measure-figure.mjs exit-code rules).

stations.bible: §5 Proportion bands — Hard defect (any acceptance capture)
stations.notes: Bible: 'Outside 0.36–0.44 is look-breaking regardless of the parameter file.'

stations.bible: §5 Proportion bands — Finished citizen height (REC-5); also §4 Baseline rig card, Figures row ('Citizen height 1.8 units')
stations.notes: The Bible states the height with no tolerance, so the gate reports measured-vs-target and never pass/fails it. Inventing a tolerance would be inventing a number.

stations.bible: §5 Proportion bands — Props ('125% ±10 of natural scale'); §4 Baseline rig card, Figures row ('carried props 125% (book 150%)')
stations.notes: Band read as 125% ± 10 percentage points. Not measured by measure-figure.mjs, which measures figures, not props; recorded here because the Bible states it as a proportion station.
A width/volume treatment, not a height share; not measured by measure-figure.mjs. The gate deliberately does not judge silhouette (see README.md).

stations.bible: §5 Proportion bands — Finished citizen height row ('standard door 2.2 units (≈1.22×, as-built ratio, not a defect)')
stations.notes: Recorded exactly as the Bible frames it: an as-built reference ratio, explicitly not a defect when it differs.

unmeasurable.description: The head mesh is scaled 'about the neck pivot'; the pivot's position is described in prose only, with no numeric offset stated. There is nothing to encode and nothing a measurement could check. The 1.30× factor itself is numeric and lives under procedureFactors.
